content_sections.heading: RGU Teaching Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
RGU Teaching Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Teaching Assistant: Post Graduate degree in Commerce with minimum 55% marks (or equivalent grade) from an accredited Indian University or equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University. Must have cleared NET conducted by UGC/CSIR or similar test like SLET/SET. PhD holders exempted from NET/SLET/SET. Desirable: PhD in Commerce with good knowledge of subject domain.

content_sections.heading: RGU Teaching Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Consolidated Rs. 1000/- per class to maximum Rs. 40000/- per month

content_sections.heading: RGU Teaching Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
RGU Teaching Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for RGU Teaching Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RGU Teaching Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a walk-in interview. Candidates need to attend the interview on the specified date, which is 01 September 2026. There is no separate application deadline before the interview.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Teaching Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in Commerce with a minimum of 55% marks. Additionally, they should have cleared the NET/SLET/SET examination or be exempted from it by holding a PhD.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Teaching Assistant position?
faq.answer: The salary is consolidated and ranges from Rs. 1000/- per class to a maximum of Rs. 40000/- per month, depending on the number of classes taken.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Teaching Assistant post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Teaching Assistant post at Rajiv Gandhi University.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for RGU Teaching Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Teaching Assistant position will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates will be evaluated based on their qualifications and performance during the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Rajiv Gandhi University, located in Doimukh, Arunachal Pradesh. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including educational certificates, mark sheets, NET/SLET/SET certificates, PhD certificates (if applicable), ID proof, and one set of self-attested photocopies of these documents.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age limit for the Teaching Assistant post?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify an age limit. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any age-related criteria or relaxation policies.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is ET/413/FYUP/2023(Vol-II)/471.
